description: We are a passionate team interested in medicine, AI, technology, and space exploration. Our strengths include creativity, research, problem-solving, and teamwork. We are looking for motivated members with skills in programming, AI, software development, biomedical engineering, and medical research. Join NOVA MEDIX to help us innovate healthcare beyond Earth!
summary:
NOVA MEDIX – Intelligent Health Monitoring for Astronauts

NOVA MEDIX is an AI-assisted astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support human health during long-duration space missions, especially journeys to Mars. It addresses the five major hazards of human spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity, and hostile or closed environments.

We developed an interactive digital platform that combines simulated health indicators, astronaut self-assessments, personalized precautionary recommendations, and health-risk awareness in one centralized experience.

What makes NOVA MEDIX unique is its integrated approach: instead of treating each spaceflight hazard separately, it connects all five hazards within one astronaut-focused health-support platform. It transforms complex space-health research into an interactive, accessible experience that helps astronauts understand potential risks and take a more proactive approach to their well-being.

By combining NASA-based research, AI-assisted development, and an engaging interface, NOVA MEDIX explores a new approach to preventive healthcare beyond Earth. Its ultimate goal is to contribute to safer, smarter, and more sustainable human space exploration.
details:
NOVA MEDIX – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring Platform

NOVA MEDIX is an AI-assisted astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support human health and safety during long-duration space missions, particularly journeys to Mars. It addresses the five major hazards of human spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity, and hostile or closed environments.

The platform provides an interactive health-monitoring experience where astronauts can review simulated health indicators, complete self-assessments, monitor potential health concerns, and receive personalized guidance and precautionary recommendations. It brings important health information together in one accessible interface, helping astronauts understand changes in their well-being and make more informed decisions.

NOVA MEDIX aims to improve health awareness, support early identification of potential concerns, and encourage preventive healthcare in environments where immediate medical assistance may be limited. Its intended long-term impact is to contribute to safer, more sustainable human space exploration.

The project was developed using Lovable for the interactive software prototype, AI-assisted development tools, ChatGPT for research assistance and content development, and Canva for presentation design. The prototype focuses on an accessible digital interface rather than requiring additional physical hardware.

Its creativity lies in combining multiple spaceflight health risks into one integrated, astronaut-focused platform instead of treating each hazard separately. Our team considered scientific credibility, NASA research, usability, accessibility, privacy, mission limitations, and the importance of distinguishing educational simulations from real medical measurements.

NOVA MEDIX envisions a future in which astronaut health is continuously supported through intelligent, accessible, and preventive digital healthcare.
